plugins.name: Traffica UE Analytics
plugins.description:
Traffica UE Analytics is a QGIS plugin designed to perform indicative traffic flow analysis using spatial network modeling and synthetic origin-destination generation.

The plugin converts road network geometry, population distribution, and point-of-interest (POI) data into a synthetic mobility demand model
and assigns the resulting flows onto the road network using transport assignment algorithms.

The analytical framework integrates gravity-based trip generation, grid-based zoning, and network-based route assignment
to estimate traffic flow patterns where traditional OD survey data is unavailable.

The plugin supports both deterministic All-or-Nothing (AoN) assignment and probabilistic multi-path assignment using a Path-Size Logit (PSL) formulation,
enabling the exploration of route choice variability within urban transport systems.

Optional User Equilibrium (UE) iterations using the Bureau of Public Roads (BPR) congestion function and Method of Successive Averages (MSA)
allow approximate congestion feedback within the synthetic traffic model.

The plugin includes the following main analytical components:
1. Network Preparation – splits road networks at intersections and filters non-vehicular links to build a clean transport graph.
2. Grid-Based Zoning Generator – creates spatial zones within a study boundary to serve as origin and destination units.
3. Synthetic OD Generator – estimates trip flows using a gravity model based on population mass and POI attraction.
4. Traffic Assignment Engine – assigns OD flows to the network using AoN or probabilistic multi-path route choice models.
5. Congestion Simulation – applies BPR travel time functions with optional User Equilibrium iterations.
6. Mobility Output Generator – produces edge flow layers, OD desire lines, and zone-level mobility indicators.
plugins.about:
Traffica UE Analytics provides an integrated spatial analytics framework for exploring urban mobility patterns
using open spatial datasets and network modeling techniques.

The plugin is designed to support transport planners, urban researchers, and spatial analysts
in conducting preliminary traffic flow assessments when detailed mobility survey data is unavailable.

By combining spatial zoning, gravity-based demand modeling, and network assignment algorithms,
the framework enables rapid evaluation of potential traffic corridors, congestion hotspots,
and accessibility relationships within urban regions.

The resulting outputs can support corridor screening, scenario comparison,
infrastructure planning analysis, and urban mobility research within a GIS environment.
plugins.author: Maya Safira, Firman Afrianto

plugins.name: Groundsource Indonesia Flood Profiler
plugins.description:
Groundsource Indonesia Flood Profiler is a QGIS plugin designed to analyze and profile historical flood events across Indonesia using the Groundsource global flood dataset.

The plugin extracts and analyzes flood events reported in the Groundsource dataset within user-defined administrative or study boundaries. It generates spatial and temporal flood intelligence profiles that summarize historical flood occurrence patterns for cities, districts, watersheds, or planning regions.

The Groundsource dataset compiles flood events extracted from global news reports and structured into a geospatial dataset, enabling retrospective analysis of flood occurrence patterns.

This tool allows planners, disaster risk analysts, and researchers to transform raw Groundsource event data into actionable spatial intelligence through automated profiling workflows.

The plugin is designed for applications including:
1. Historical flood event profiling within planning boundaries
2. Flood hotspot identification and spatial clustering
3. Temporal flood trend analysis and event seasonality
4. Flood exposure assessment for urban and regional planning
5. Disaster risk intelligence and decision-support mapping
plugins.about:
Groundsource Indonesia Flood Profiler provides a geospatial analytical framework to convert the Groundsource flood event dataset into interpretable flood intelligence indicators.

The tool automatically downloads and caches the Groundsource dataset and performs spatial intersection with user-defined boundaries to identify flood events relevant to a specific study area.

Analytical outputs include flood event density mapping, temporal trend analysis, hotspot identification, and computation of the Historical Flood Intelligence Index (HFII). The workflow also produces multiple visual analytics including temporal charts, hotspot maps, and spatial summaries.

The plugin is designed to support disaster risk analysis, spatial planning, climate adaptation studies, and flood risk communication for Indonesian regions.

Dataset Citation:
Mayo, R., Zlydenko, O., Bootbool, M., Fronman, S., Gilon, O., Hassidim, A., Kratzert, F., Loike, G., Matias, Y., Nakar, Y., Nearing, G., Sayag, R., Sicherman, A., Zemach, I., & Cohen, D. (2026). plugins.name: InSAR Suite
plugins.description: Integrated suite for loading, processing and analysis of PSI displacement data
plugins.about:
InSAR Suite is an integrated QGIS plugin that brings together five tools for PSI (Persistent Scatterer Interferometry) data analysis into a single dedicated toolbar.

- InSAR Load: loads PSI point layers from GeoPackage, Shapefile or GDB files using a polygon index layer, or reactivates an index already present in the project.
- InSAR EWUD: decomposes LOS velocities from ascending/descending SAR data into East-West and Up-Down components, with automatic resampling grid creation (square or hexagonal cells). Outputs include Na and Nd fields (number of PS points used per cell).
- InSAR VIS: calculates the detectable movement percentage (pc_mov) based on SAR acquisition geometry and terrain morphology derived from a DEM. Output can be saved as a permanent GeoPackage.
- InSAR TS: time series analysis tools including data quality and homogeneity check (with skewness and kurtosis), automatic kinematic analysis, seasonal decomposition (STL), piecewise non-linear analysis, temporal anomaly detection, and multi-zone comparison. Supports DYYYYMMDD and YYYYMMDD date field formats.
- InSAR Polygons: automatic delineation of deformation areas from PS data using buffer and geometric dissolve by velocity class, with hierarchical clipping and optional morphological smoothing.

plugins.name: QGIS Ledger
plugins.description: Enterprise-grade Git-like version control for QGIS. Features semantic geometric diffing, deterministic rollback, and multi-cloud synchronization (Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive).
plugins.about:
============================================================
ITALIANO
============================================================
QGIS Ledger — Versioning di Livello Enterprise per QGIS
Sistema di tracciamento storico e sincronizzazione cloud progettato per l'integrità dei dati spaziali, senza dipendenze esterne. Ottimizzato per QGIS 3.x e QGIS 4 (Qt6).

FUNZIONALITÀ PRINCIPALI:
- Architettura a Snapshot: Commit atomici di layer e progetti in SQLite locale.
- Diff Semantico-Visuale: Analisi geometrica delle differenze tra versioni.
- Rollback Deterministico: Ripristino istantaneo di dati e stili.
- Sincronizzazione Cloud: Supporto nativo per Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive e GDrive.
- Merge Wizard: Gestione conflitti in split-screen.

============================================================
ENGLISH
============================================================
QGIS Ledger — Enterprise-Grade Version Control for QGIS
Comprehensive historical tracking and cloud synchronization engine engineered for geospatial data integrity, operating entirely dependency-free across QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4 (Qt6).

CORE FEATURES:
- Snapshot Architecture: Atomic commits of layers and projects in local SQLite.
- Semantic Visual Diff: Geometric analysis of differences between versions.
- Deterministic Rollback: Instant restoration of data and styling.
- Cloud Synchronization: Native support for Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive, and GDrive.
- Merge Wizard: Split-screen conflict resolution.
plugins.author: Dott. Sarino Alfonso Grande

plugins.name: BKompV Rechner
plugins.description: Automated ecological impact assessment according to BKompV.
plugins.about: Dieses Plugin automatisiert die Eingriffs-Ausgleichs-Bilanzierung nach BKompV. Es bietet ein Einzelbaum-Modul, Habitat-Boni (+3 WE) und ein intelligentes Projektions-Management. This tool reduces manual processing time and minimizes errors in environmental impact assessments, ensuring high-quality results for official approval processes.
plugins.author: Lienus Rob

plugins.name: Transmittance Layer ctl
plugins.description: Group layers and control their opacity, order, and labeling as a single blended layer.
plugins.about:
Tag any QGIS layer group as a "Transmittance Group" to open an interactive 2D control panel.

The canvas plots each layer as a draggable dot — X axis controls stacking order, Y axis controls opacity. Drag a dot to adjust both at once. Click a dot to toggle its visibility.

Key features:
- Real-time opacity and order editing with immediate map feedback
- Label control: a △ indicator selects which layer displays its QGIS label
- Exclusive Control mode: click any dot to show only that layer and its label; cycle through layers with arrow keys
- Opacity clamping: define an upper/lower opacity range applied across all layers
- Presets (×4): save and restore full panel states, including order, opacity, clamping, and exclusive control settings

Designed for workflows that involve comparing multiple overlapping layers — such as elevation models, orthophotos, and feature layers — where visual blending and quick layer switching matter.
plugins.author: Hideharu Masai

plugins.description: 面向国土空间规划与测绘工作的 QGIS AI 助手，支持问答、处理算法执行、图层操作和按规程符号化。

plugins.author: Vicky Sharma

plugins.name: Horizon Projector
plugins.description: Horizon Projector is a complete plugin for nautical and geodetic calculations in QGIS.
plugins.about:
Key features:
1) Distance to horizon calculation based on observer height,
2) Maximum distance calculation for object viewing,
3) Geodetic projection via magnetic azimuth and distance with declination correction,
4) Creation of distance rings in nautical miles with color gradient,
5) Export to GPX, KML, Shapefile, and GeoJSON. Ideal for maritime navigation, route planning, visibility studies, search and rescue, and geodetic applications.

All calculations consider the curvature of the Earth using precise geodetic formulas.
plugins.author: Alberto Rodrigues

plugins.name: Canva Focus
plugins.description: Plugin to view and control the focus in the central area of ​​the map.
plugins.about:
Canva Focus is a plugin that helps identify and work with the center of the map window in QGIS. With this plugin you can:
Display an adjustable border that delimits the central focus zone of the map
Adjust the size of the focus zone using a slider
Activate/deactivate the focus mode with a toggle button
Display the exact center of the focus zone with a crosshair marker
Automatically center the map when clicking outside the focus zone when the mode is activated
Ideal for work that requires precision in positioning and visualizing the center of the map.
plugins.author: Alberto Rodrigues

plugins.name: Atlas Pro Germany
plugins.description: Access and download 1m resolution German elevation data (DEM/DSM) directly within QGIS.
plugins.about: Atlas Pro Germany integrates the Atlas web application (https://atlas.geo-code.de) into QGIS as a dock widget. It allows you to browse, select, and export 1-meter resolution Digital Elevation Models (DEM) and Digital Surface Models (DSM) covering all of Germany. Downloaded GeoTIFF/COG files can be loaded directly into your QGIS project with a single click. Requires an internet connection. Registration on atlas.geo-code.de is required for data export. Prices start at 5 Euro.
plugins.author: Geocode

plugins.name: QGarage
plugins.description: Modular app-hosting framework for QGIS with per-app uv/pixi environments, Processing integration, and a unified dashboard for isolated mini-tools.
plugins.about: QGarage is a plugin-within-a-plugin framework for QGIS that installs, manages, and runs isolated mini-tools from a single dashboard. Version 2 adds dual uv/pixi backends for app environments, asynchronous environment preparation during installs, clearer setup error reporting, Processing Toolbox integration for declarative apps, richer scaffolding with backend selection and custom destinations, and bundled TestToolbox examples for both uv and pixi workflows. Install the plugin from the QGIS Plugin Manager, then configure uv and/or pixi in QGarage settings based on the apps you want to run.
plugins.author: Matt Adams

plugins.name: ArcGIS ImageServer Downloader
plugins.description: Download raster tiles from ArcGIS ImageServer REST services and create Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs)
plugins.about: Download raster tiles from ArcGIS ImageServer REST services at their native resolution and assemble them into Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs). Supports large-area downloads via a draw-on-canvas bbox tool and parallel tile fetching. Includes a dock widget for browsing and selecting services, plus Processing algorithms for scripted and batch workflows. Zero external dependencies — requires only QGIS and its bundled GDAL. Compatible with QGIS 3.28+ (Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (Qt6). Ships with GIS Steiermark pre-configured; custom servers can be added.
plugins.author: Harald Kristen

Exports the coordinates of the constituent points of features selected from Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries brush polygons (GeoJSON) to CSV in a plane orthogonal coordinate system.

Run rules in the background, inspect errors in a dockable inspector, assign/status-manage errors, export reports, and apply safe auto-fixes.

A QGIS plugin for importing and exporting XML and TXT files in NF EN 13508-2 format from Wincan or other sources.

plugins.name: Text2Map
plugins.description: Convert pasted text (lat/lon, JSON, GeoJSON, WKT) into temporary geometry layers. Works with both QGIS 3 and QGIS 4.
plugins.about:
Text2Map lets you quickly visualise spatial data from plain text without leaving QGIS.
Compatible with QGIS 3.16+ (Qt5) and QGIS 4.0+ (Qt6).

Supported input formats:
- Decimal lat/lon pairs (comma, space, or semicolon separated; one per line)
- DMS coordinates (Degrees Minutes Seconds)
- JSON objects / arrays with lat/lon key variants
- GeoJSON (FeatureCollection, Feature, or bare geometry)
- WKT (POINT, LINESTRING, POLYGON and MULTI variants)

Features:
- Automatic format detection
- Creates a temporary memory layer in EPSG:4326
- Preserves JSON / GeoJSON properties as attribute fields
- Custom layer naming
- Auto-zooms map canvas to the new layer
- Full error messages on parse failure
plugins.author: Pradip

plugins.name: UrbisMap Click
plugins.description: Open UrbisMap in an external browser by clicking a point on the map
plugins.about: Click the plugin button, then click on the map to open UrbisMap with the latitude and longitude of the selected point.
plugins.author: Roberto Pilleri

plugins.name: Service Access Mapper
plugins.description: Generate travel-time catchments (isochrones) to services using road networks, estimate population coverage using WorldPop data, and summarize statistics by admin boundaries.
plugins.about:
Service Access Mapper computes travel-time catchment areas (isochrones) around service points such as health facilities, schools, and other amenities using road network analysis.

Features:
- Travel-time and distance isochrone generation with customizable thresholds
- Three speed models: field-based, road class mapping (with Ghana defaults), constant
- Automatic WorldPop population raster download with country auto-detection
- Per-threshold population coverage breakdown (band and cumulative)
- Coverage statistics by administrative boundaries with population percentages
- Underserved area identification with population estimates
- Distance decay analysis from demand points to services
- Service point snapping to road networks
- Background processing with progress feedback
- Profile save/load for reusable configurations
- CSV export of admin and population statistics

No external Python packages required — uses only PyQGIS, QGIS Processing, and Python standard library.
plugins.author: Ben Emunah Aikins

plugins.name: Center Point on Line
plugins.description: Generate center (centroid) point from line features using processing algorithm
plugins.about: Center Point on Line is a lightweight QGIS plugin that generates center (centroid) points from line features. It fixes geometries, reprojects data, and calculates midpoint-based centroids automatically using QGIS processing tools.
plugins.author: Anustup Jana

plugins.name: Landuse Analyzer

plugins.about: A QGIS plugin that analyzes land use patterns within user-drawn polygons using OpenStreetMap data. Extracts and classifies land use categories with area calculations and summary statistics.

plugins.name: LizPack Publisher
plugins.description: LizPack Publisher is a QGIS plugin that connects directly to your LizPack instance. It allows you to publish project folders, manage remote files via SFTP, download QGIS projects with all their dependencies, and import vector layers into your LizPack PostGIS database — all from within the QGIS interface. Streamline your web mapping workflow without switching between tools.
plugins.about: LizPack Publisher connects QGIS to your LizPack instance, enabling you to publish project folders, manage remote files via SFTP, download QGIS projects with all their dependencies, and import vector layers into your LizPack PostGIS database. Simplify your web mapping workflow without ever leaving QGIS.
plugins.author: LizPack - GEODONNEE INC

plugins.name: Layer Slider
plugins.description: Navigate and compose ordered layers with a slider, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic raster compositing.
plugins.about:
Layer Slider is a QGIS plugin for navigating and composing ordered layers or layer groups with an intuitive slider, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic layer compositing.

It is designed for any workflow where you need to flip through a sequence of layers — whether they represent increasing depth (e.g. GPR depth slices), successive points in time (e.g. historical satellite imagery), or alternative visualizations of the same area (e.g. DTM hillshade, slope, aspect). Key features include slider and keyboard navigation, dynamic averaged raster composites, full layer tree integration, caching, and GeoTIFF export.

For a demo, instructions and comparison to alternatives, see the homepage.

If you use Layer Slider in your academic work, please cite it:
Obermayer, M. (2026). Layer Slider – QGIS Plugin (v1.1.1). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19665151 . Available at: https://github.com/mobermayer/layer-slider

For collaboration and research- or software-related inquiries, visit my homepage https://mobermayer.at .
plugins.author: Maximilian Obermayer

plugins.description: Align polygon boundaries instantly with intelligent snap tolerance. Works across layers or within same layer, automatically calculating optimal snap distance based on feature size and separation
plugins.about: This plugin fixes alignment issues by snapping vertices to both nodes and segments.

plugins.description: AI-powered image editing for geospatial (Nano Banana 2). Select a zone, describe the change, get a georeferenced result.
plugins.about:
• Select & transform: draw a rectangle on your map, describe the change to AI with a prompt

• Works on any layer: local rasters (GeoTIFF, JPG, PNG) & online layers (WMS, XYZ tiles)

• Georeferenced output: results are saved as GeoTIFF with full spatial metadata

• Universal: Windows, macOS, Linux

Search by county or map extent, download tiles with concurrent transfers,
mosaic into VRT, and generate hillshade — all from the Processing toolbox.
Powered by abovepy. No credentials required.

plugins.name: Elevation Profile
plugins.description: High-Precision 2D Terrain Profiling Tool for QGIS.
plugins.about:
Elevation Profile is an essential tool for Network Planning and Optimization (NPO) Engineers and GIS professionals. It allows users to instantly generate highly accurate 2D elevation profiles directly from loaded local DEM/Raster data.

Features included in this Standard version:
* Offline DEM Profiling: Seamlessly generate profiles from local Raster files (e.g., DEMNAS, SRTM, AW3D30).
* Interactive Line Drawing: Draw a path on the map with real-time live tooltips displaying Azimuth and Distance.
* Dynamic Terrain Smoothing: Adjust Sigma values on the fly to filter noise from raw DEM sources.
* QGIS 4 Ready: Fully refactored to support PyQt6 while maintaining seamless backward compatibility with QGIS 3.x.
* Real-Time Summary: Automatically calculates total distance, minimum, maximum, and average elevation.
* High-Res Export: Export elevation profiles to PNG or scalable SVG formats for professional technical reporting.

🔒 UPGRADE TO PRO VERSION:
Unlock advanced RF Audit tools and global datasets by upgrading to the Pro version! Pro features include:
* Advanced LoS Viewer: Microwave link planning with Tx/Rx tower heights, Earth bulge, K-Factor, and 60% Fresnel Zone clearance.
* Online DEM APIs: Access Open-Meteo 90m & OpenTopoData 30m globally without needing local raster files.
* Population Metrics: Extract 1D demographic density profiles and estimate total population within your corridor.
* Dual Mode UI: Instantly toggle between Dark Mode and elegant Ivory Light Mode.
* Bonus: Includes the Embed Legend Pro plugin for free!
plugins.author: Jujun Junaedi

plugins.name: Azayaka

plugins.about: Azayaka is a Python package for SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) processing and a simple InSAR Project. It focuses on geometry calculations for JAXA CEOS and SICD formats.

plugins.name: Landcover Encoding Plugin
plugins.description: Assigns each polygon the dominant and subdominant land cover class from an underlying raster with proportional coverage percentages. Includes a built-in land cover legend (34 classes) with optional custom CSV override.
plugins.about: A processing-based plugin for land cover classification of segmented polygons. For each polygon in a vector layer, the tool extracts raster pixel values, computes the majority (dominant) and second-majority (subdominant) classes, and resolves class labels from a built-in legend or a user-supplied CSV. Invalid geometries are repaired automatically. CRS mismatches are handled on the fly.
plugins.author: Santhosh M

plugins.name: QuickSector
plugins.description: Generate RF sector polygons in seconds inside QGIS. Designed for telecom engineers to automate sector creation.
plugins.about:
QuickSector is part of the Tofreq ecosystem, built for RF engineers who want to create sector polygons quickly and accurately inside QGIS.
Key Features:
- Generate sector polygons from site parameters
- Adjustable azimuth, beamwidth, and tilt
- Add sectors to any existing QGIS layer
- Clean KML export with popup tables
- Designed for real-world RF planning workflows
Workflow:
- Select or import site data
- Generate sector polygons instantly
- Adjust parameters directly in QGIS
- Export results for visualization and reporting
Support: https://buymeacoffee.com/nattawutpr
plugins.author: Nattawut Prommayom

plugins.name: Discrete Proximity Framework
plugins.description: QGIS plugin for reachability and distance analysis using Origin-Destination Matrices (ODM)
plugins.about: Multiple reachability analysis tools supporting Active Mobility, Public Transport, Combined Multimodal models, and POI-based analysis
plugins.author: inphysica technology

plugins.name: scan_qt6_compat
plugins.description: This plugin scans a QGIS 3 plugin and makes the necessary modifications to allow it to work together on both QGIS 3 and QGIS 4.
plugins.about: This plugin scans a QGIS 3 plugin and makes the necessary modifications to allow it to function together on both QGIS 3 and QGIS 4. A complete report of the changes made is generated afterward.
plugins.author: François THEVAND

plugins.name: Aerodrome_Spatial_Planner
plugins.description: A QGIS plugin based on ICAO airport runway planning and site feasibility analysis. This plugin provides a full suite for airport runway planning inspired from ICAO Annex 14 and Doc 9157.
plugins.about:
A QGIS plugin based on ICAO airport runway planning and site feasibility analysis. It fetches historical weather data from the Open-Meteo API, performs wind analysis, calculates runway length and declared distances, generates obstacle limitation surfaces, and produces GeoPackage outputs, maps, and compliance reports. Disclaimer: This plugin implements algorithms based on ICAO Annex 14 and Doc 9157 design parameters. It does not include, reproduce or distribute any ICAO copyrighted documents. Users must obtain official ICAO publications independently for compliance verification. This plugin is for educational and planning assistance purposes only. It is not an official ICAO product and is not certified by any aviation authority. The ICAO standards referenced are based on publicly available information (Annex 14, Doc 9157) and the user is responsible for verifying all outputs with official aerodrome design requirements. The author does not claim ownership of ICAO intellectual property; all ICAO material used is for reference only under fair use for educational purposes.
Install Dependencies in OSGEO4W with this command:  
pip install numpy pandas requests rasterio geopandas shapely pyproj geographiclib matplotlib scipy openpyxl reportlab

Watch tutorial- https://youtu.be/WoMGmBmxFoo?si=dPDysez8529-U2rm
plugins.author: Rahul Pandey

plugins.name: Show And Hide
plugins.description:
A simple plugin that allows you to turn visible vector, raster and point cloud layers on and off.
The plugin remembers the state of layers and turns off/on only those that were originally active.
plugins.about:
A simple plugin that allows you to turn visible vector, raster and point cloud layers on and off.
The plugin remembers the state of layers and turns off/on only those that were originally active.
plugins.author: Tomasz Mazuga

plugins.name: Self Intersection Check
plugins.description: A QGIS plugin to check for self-intersections and overlaps in polygon layers.
plugins.about: This plugin provides a Processing algorithm to identify self-intersections and overlaps in polygon layers, outputting invalid features with a reason.
plugins.author: Anustup Jana

plugins.name: Viewshed Calculator
plugins.description: Calculate viewshed from DSM using project layers, file inputs, or generated viewpoint grids with optional CHM validation
plugins.about: This plugin calculates visibility analysis (viewshed) from Digital Surface Models (DSM) based on observer points from files or QGIS project layers. It supports optional Canopy Height Model (CHM) validation, can generate viewpoint grids from an extent or polygon source, and outputs results as a GeoTIFF raster showing maximum visible area per cell.
plugins.author: Anna Deckmyn

plugins.name: Dynamic Distance Buffer Tool
plugins.description: Generate multiple concentric buffer rings at dynamic user-defined distances.
plugins.about:
Creates non-overlapping ring (donut) or cumulative disc buffers around
point, line, or polygon features. Distances can be entered manually as a
comma-separated list or read dynamically from a numeric attribute field.
Fully integrated with the QGIS Processing Framework.
plugins.author: Ben Emunah Aikins

plugins.name: OSM Extractor by Jambar Lab
plugins.description: Extract OpenStreetMap data (roads, waterways, buildings, schools, health facilities) from any layer extent. Works worldwide.
plugins.about: OSM Extractor by Jambar Lab lets you extract OpenStreetMap data directly into QGIS from any vector layer extent — no manual download needed. Supported data types: roads, waterways, buildings, schools and health facilities. Data is fetched via the Overpass API, converted to vector layers, and optionally clipped to the exact boundary. Designed for reliable use in any network condition, from high-speed connections to low-bandwidth field environments. Works anywhere in the world. Compatible with QGIS 3.16 and above, including QGIS 4.x.
plugins.author: Jambar Lab

plugins.name: Black Frame Remover
plugins.description: Removes the black border/frame from georeferenced rasters and aerial imagery using Clip by Mask Layer with alpha channel transparency.
plugins.about: When georeferencing old maps or aerial imagery in QGIS, the output raster often has an unwanted black frame around the actual image content. This plugin automates the removal by detecting the valid image area, generating a mask polygon, and clipping the raster with alpha transparency. Replicating the manual workflow of Raster > Extraction > Clip Raster by Mask Layer with the alpha channel box ticked.
plugins.author: Prince Osei Boateng

plugins.name: GeoExtractor
plugins.description: One-click extraction of OpenStreetMap data with automatic download, processing, and clipping.
plugins.about: GeoExtractor is a QGIS plugin that allows users to easily extract OpenStreetMap data within a selected area. It automates the entire workflow including data retrieval via Overpass API, conversion to GeoJSON, and clipping to a user-defined boundary.
plugins.author: Mabika Clément

plugins.name: GeoSeg Studio
plugins.description: Full-pipeline deep learning semantic segmentation for geospatial raster data.
plugins.about: GeoSeg Studio is a complete deep learning segmentation environment for QGIS. It covers the full workflow in one plugin: prepare training data (clip, split, augment), train your own segmentation model, evaluate performance, run predictions on new rasters, and post-process vector outputs — all without leaving QGIS.
plugins.author: Salar Ghaffarian

plugins.name: Spatial Relationship Mapper
plugins.description: Creates spatial relationships between two polygon layers and links their attributes
plugins.about: Spatial Relationship Mapper is a QGIS processing plugin designed to establish and analyze spatial relationships between two polygon layers. The tool allows users to select any two input layers along with their respective unique ID fields, and automatically detects intersecting features using an optimized spatial indexing approach. The plugin generates two output layers, where each feature contains a new attribute field ("related_ids") that stores the IDs of intersecting features from the opposite layer. This enables efficient mapping of one-to-one, one-to-many, or many-to-many spatial relationships. It is particularly useful in workflows such as parcel-to-building mapping, land use analysis, asset management, zoning validation, and urban planning. The plugin supports both temporary and permanent outputs, integrates seamlessly with the QGIS Processing Toolbox, and is designed for performance, accuracy, and ease of use. This plugin is ideal for GIS analysts, planners, and developers who need a quick and reliable way to generate spatial relationships between polygon datasets.
plugins.author: Anustup Jana

plugins.name: QuickSite
plugins.description: Bulk RF site automation in QGIS — generate multi-layer networks from CSV and export complete projects in seconds.
plugins.about:
QuickSite is part of the Tofreq ecosystem, built for RF engineers who want to automate large-scale network design inside QGIS.
Key Features:
- Generate multi-site networks instantly from CSV
- Automatic multi-band layer creation (2G/3G/4G/5G)
- Customize radius, color, and opacity per band
- Export all layers into a single KML with folder structure
- Built for large-scale RF planning workflows
Workflow:
- Import CSV to generate full network layers
- Use QuickSector to add or adjust sectors
- Export the entire project as a clean KML
plugins.author: Nattawut Prommayom

plugins.name: PlanX
plugins.description: PlanX is a comprehensive suite of spatial-planning tools for QGIS. It provides modules for data import, advanced spatial statistics, zoning-rule workflows, and urban-design analyses.
plugins.about: PlanX equips city-planners and GIS professionals with a modular toolbox for Turkish and international planning tasks. Each sub-plugin offers a guided UI, robust error handling, and silent-mode batch capabilities, logically organized under a single PlanX menu. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning.
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: PlanX CAD Toolset
plugins.description: Lightweight and fast CAD toolset for urban planning processes in QGIS. Features include drawing, editing, transforming, measuring, and road platform design.
plugins.about: PlanX CAD Toolset is a lightweight, fast, and modular QGIS plugin explicitly designed for urban planning processes. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning. It brings 18+ CAD-like features direct to QGIS including Line, Polyline, Rectangle, Polygon, Circle, Arc, Offset, Trim, Extend, Fillet, and more. It includes a modern dockable panel UI, native snapping support, and an interactive road platform creation tool.
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: PlanX Uygulama İmar Planı (Master Plan) Toolset
plugins.description: PlanX Spatial Planning Plugins - A toolset automating the Uygulama İmar Planı (UIP - Master Plan) implementation processes.
plugins.about: Automated planning tools prepared with the vision of urban resilience, advanced spatial analysis, and optimization-based planning. Generates rapid UIP base layers and layouts. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning.
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: PlanX Settlement Planning Toolset
plugins.description: PlanX Settlement Planning Tools. A 9-stage sequential workflow toolset capable of generating blocks, parcels, building footprints, parking, and landscapes.
plugins.about: Built with a vision of urban resilience, spatial analysis, and optimization-based planning, this toolset automates Settlement Plan generation. It spans 9 consecutive processes, allowing for complete production lines starting from basic block sub-division all the way to building placement, parking layout design, and landscape generation. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning.
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: SVG Export
plugins.description: Export vector layers to SVG with per-feature IDs and an optional interactive HTML companion
plugins.about: Exports selected QGIS vector layers to a single SVG file. Each feature gets an ID attribute derived from a chosen field, making the SVG easy to style or script in vector editors and browsers. Optionally generates an interactive HTML file with click-to-highlight and search functionality.
plugins.author: Peppo Herney

plugins.name: CoMapeo Map Builder
plugins.description: Generates SMP files for CoMapeo using proper XYZ Web Mercator tiling
plugins.about: Generates XYZ-compliant SMP (Styled Map Package) files for CoMapeo. Uses proper Web Mercator projection and standard tiling scheme compatible with OpenStreetMap, MapLibre, and other mapping systems.
plugins.author: Awana Digital

plugins.name: MEMO Groundwater Network Design
plugins.description: Professional tool for groundwater monitoring well network efficiency, plume dispersion simulation, and probabilistic risk assessment. (專業地下水監測井網效率評估、污染團擴散模擬與機率風險分析工具。)
plugins.about:
【v1.2 版摘要 / v1.2 Version Summary】
[中文版]
本套件專為地下水調查與整治規畫設計，提供三大核心模組：
1. MEMO：監測井網效能評估與盲區分析。
2. PLUME：點污染源之污染團擴散動態模擬。
3. COPRO：基於蒙地卡羅法之水文機率風險評估。
支援多邊形範圍輸出、流向箭頭標示與中英文雙語摘要報告產出。
[English Version]
A professional suite designed for groundwater investigation and remediation planning, featuring three core modules:
1. MEMO: Well network efficiency evaluation and blind spot analysis.
2. PLUME: Dynamic plume dispersion simulation based on point sources.
3. COPRO: Probabilistic risk assessment using Monte Carlo simulation.
Supports polygon output, flow direction arrows, and automated bilingual summary reports.
plugins.author: RayTai

plugins.name: Cluster Generator
plugins.description: Creates cluster polygons from point, line, and polygon layers using an optional attribute field.
plugins.about: Cluster Generator creates cluster polygons from point, line, and polygon input layers. Clusters can be generated from an attribute field or, if no attribute is selected, as a single cluster for the whole layer. The plugin supports optional boundary clipping, temporary or saved outputs, categorized styling, labeling from the name field, and selected-features workflows. The current package is intended for QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x.
plugins.author: Senol Baskaya

plugins.name: GeoLineage
plugins.description: Track data lineage in GeoPackage files — records processing, edits, and exports automatically.
plugins.about: GeoLineage embeds lineage metadata directly inside GeoPackage files. Every processing step, manual edit, and file export is recorded in a _lineage table, creating a permanent chain of custody for geospatial data. The plugin intercepts QGIS processing operations, tracks manual edits, and detects exports — all without modifying existing data.
plugins.author: RafDouglas C. Tommasi

plugins.name: Macro
plugins.description: Tool and library to create macros in QGIS
plugins.about: This plugin adds a Macro panel into the Debugging/Development Tools dock widget to record and play various macros.
plugins.author: Joonalai

plugins.name: txt2tif DEM builder
plugins.description:
G空間情報センター等でダウンロードできるtxt/csv形式のDEMをgeotiff形式に変換するプラグインです。
This plugin converts DEM data in txt/csv format (e.g., from the Geospatial Information Center) to GeoTIFF.
plugins.about:
このプラグインは、G空間情報センターなどからダウンロードできる DEM の txt/csv ファイルを、GeoTIFF 形式に変換するためのツールです。 複数の txt/csv ファイルを 1 つのフォルダにまとめて入力することで、それらを自動的に結合した DEM（マージ済み GeoTIFF）を出力することもできます。 なお、txt に含まれる各点の座標は、出力される GeoTIFF のラスタセルの中心に対応するように設定されています。
This plugin converts DEM data in txt/csv format (e.g., downloaded from the Geospatial Information Center) into GeoTIFF. Multiple txt/csv files in a folder can be processed together and merged into a single DEM (merged GeoTIFF). The coordinates of each input point are mapped to the center of the output raster cells.
plugins.author: Mizuki TAKIGAWA

plugins.name: Delft3D File Manager
plugins.description: Imports and exports Delft3D files.
plugins.about: Comprehensive QGIS toolbox for Delft3D workflows: import and export fixed weirs, polylines, point clouds, UGRID meshes, ShorelineS outputs, and FM cross-sections; visualize cross-section profiles; write bed levels to meshes; and create, edit, and export trachytopes.
plugins.author: Victor Chavarrias

plugins.name: Quick Road Network Path AI
plugins.description: Compute the fastest path between two points on a road network using the A* algorithm with optional boundary filtering and export options.
plugins.about: Quick Road Network Path AI is a QGIS plugin that converts a road network into a graph and calculates the optimal route between two user-defined points using the A* algorithm. The plugin supports snapping, travel time estimation based on speed attributes, and export to GeoPackage or Shapefile.
plugins.author: Dimitra Pappa geospatial

plugins.name: APRIORA
plugins.description: Estimation of flow and concentration of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) in a catchment.
plugins.about:
This plugin contains a series of tools divided into two subgroups: Hydro-Module and API emission.
Hydro-Module -> useful to estimate annual mean flow and annual mean low flow in ungauged subcatchments.
API emission -> calculate the load of API from waste water treatment plants and their concentration in the river network.
Finally, a risk assessment is performed.
External dependencies: requires the Python libraries 'numpy', 'pandas' and 'scikit-learn'.
numpy and pandas are typically pre-installed with QGIS. To install scikit-learn, open the
OSGeo4W Shell and run: python -m pip install scikit-learn
(for Windows see: https://landscapearchaeology.org/2018/installing-python-packages-in-qgis-3-for-windows/).
plugins.author: Cristiano Guidi

plugins.name: PlanX: Urban Resilience
plugins.description: PlanX urban resilience suite (28 tools): seismic, heat, flood, social, emergency access, evacuation, network criticality, air, drought, synthesis, risk-recovery matrix, time-series, scenario tools, HTML/Markdown/PDF atlas, symbology.
plugins.about: 28 Processing algorithms and a QGIS dashboard for city-scale resilience screening: synthetic QA, seismic debris, heat and flood, social vulnerability, Euclidean and network emergency access, evacuation simulation with optional timestep queue, network criticality, air and drought, multi-hazard and equity-adjusted synthesis, climate projection overlay, recovery capacity, scenario sensitivity, risk-recovery priority matrix, time-series tracking, scenario templates, HTML/Markdown/PDF atlas with map-book presets, shelter arrival summaries, and symbology. DEU City and Regional Planning educational workflows.
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: MilitarySym-V
plugins.description: NATO APP-6D Military Symbology Placement Tool for Defence GIS
plugins.about: MilitarySym-V lets you place, label, and export NATO APP-6D compliant military symbols directly on any QGIS map canvas. Select from 14 symbols across Friendly, Hostile, Neutral, and Special categories. Assign unit name, size (Team to Division), and operational status (Present, Planned, Suspected, Destroyed). Export your symbol layer to KML, GeoJSON, or Shapefile. Open the QGIS Print Layout for PDF output. Works with any basemap including Google Satellite and OpenStreetMap. All coordinate transforms are handled automatically. No internet connection required.
plugins.author: Vaibhav Shivaji Nagare

plugins.name: CropSense
plugins.description: Calculate 22+ vegetation indices from multispectral drone imagery. Supports separate band TIFs and stacked GeoTIFFs. Includes custom index formula builder.
plugins.about: CropSense automates vegetation index calculation from UAV/drone multispectral imagery. Select a folder containing band sub-folders (blue, green, red, red edge, nir) or a stacked multi-band GeoTIFF. Calculates NDRE, GNDVI, NDVI, MCARI, EVI, SAVI and 16 more indices. Custom index formula builder included. All outputs are saved as GeoTIFFs and loaded into QGIS automatically.
plugins.author: Lalit BC at Map Mentors Spatial Research Lab

plugins.name: Quick Street Viewer
plugins.description: Click on map to open Google Maps and Street View instantly
plugins.about: The Quick Street Viewer plugin for QGIS is a lightweight and efficient tool that allows users to instantly open any clicked location in Google Street View. It simplifies field verification and location inspection workflows by combining map interaction with real-world visualization. Additionally, the plugin automatically copies the clicked coordinates, making it easy to reuse them in other platforms or applications.
plugins.author: Anustup Jana

plugins.name: QGIS Terminal
plugins.description: An integrated terminal for QGIS, similar to VS Code's integrated terminal.
plugins.about:
QGIS Terminal provides a dockable, integrated terminal panel within QGIS,
similar to the integrated terminal in VS Code.

Features:
- Dockable terminal panel that can be positioned anywhere in the QGIS interface
- True interactive shell with history, tab completion, and colored output
- Cross-platform support (Linux, macOS, Windows)
- ANSI color and escape sequence support
- Configurable font, color scheme, and shell
- Multiple shell support (bash, zsh, sh, PowerShell, cmd)
- Terminal resize handling
plugins.author: Qiusheng Wu

plugins.name: OpenNHMQGisConnector
plugins.description: Connects to OpenNHM tools
plugins.about:
Connecting OpenNHM and QGis.
NOTE: see installation instructions at http://docs.avaframe.org/installation.html.
If you are updating the OpenNHMQGisConnector, make sure to run UpdateAvaFrame in
the Admin Group (in your toolbox)
plugins.author: OpenNHM Team

plugins.name: YF GIS Amazonia Tools
plugins.description: Professional GIS toolkit for cadastral regularization, surveying, GNSS post-processing, agroforestry management, visual layer comparison and coordinate navigation in the Peruvian Amazon.
plugins.about:
Unified plugin integrating eight specialized tools for Peruvian Amazon surveying and forestry professionals.
CADASTRAL: Automatic technical memoir (memoria descriptiva) generator for rural land regularization; Parcel segmenter with azimuth and angle calculations; Coordinate, vertex, area and perimeter calculator (YF Tools Plus).
GEODESY / GNSS: PPK and PPP post-processing with RTKLIB, PDF technical reports, .cor output files for IGN Peru submissions.
AGROFORESTRY: Agroforestry system (SAF) generator with unique plant identification and multiple spatial distribution methods.
SEARCH AND ANALYSIS: Advanced multi-layer attribute search with report generation and visualization.
VISUAL COMPARISON (NEW): Swipe Tool ArcGIS Pro-style with interactive draggable divider, magnifier mode, adjustable transparency, PNG/PDF export. Supports raster, vector, WMS/XYZ and mesh layers.
NAVIGATION (NEW): Go-To Tool with separate input fields per format (DD/DMS/UTM/MGRS), auto-detection of UTM zone from project CRS, smart paste from Excel/WhatsApp, multi-coordinate paste to create N markers at once, Nominatim geocoder, persistent bookmarks, animated ArcGIS-style flash marker, conversion to GeoPackage/memory layer.
REQUIREMENTS: python-docx (required for memoir generation). Optional: pandas, matplotlib, reportlab for reports. Install via OSGeo4W Shell: python -m pip install python-docx pandas matplotlib reportlab. RTKLIB binaries are required separately for GNSS processing.
Designed for forestry, cadastre, topography and environmental monitoring professionals in Peru and Latin America.
plugins.author: Yuri Fabian Caller Cordova

plugins.name: FlyPath
plugins.description: Generate DJI WPML KMZ mission files for 2D orthomosaic mapping directly from QGIS
plugins.about:
FlyPath is a QGIS plugin for planning autonomous drone mapping missions and exporting
them as native DJI WPML KMZ files, loadable directly in the DJI Fly app.
Supported drones: DJI Mini 3 Pro, Mini 4 Pro.
Draw your survey area on the map, set flight altitude and overlap, preview
the flight path, and export a ready-to-fly mission file.
plugins.author: Salar Ghaffarian

plugins.name: Easy Fuzzy
plugins.description: Fuzzy overlay plugin for QGIS with step-by-step workflow
plugins.about: Easy fuzzy plugin for QGIS including raster input, training, fuzzy membership, overlay, sensitivity analysis, reclassification and validation.
plugins.author: Antonio Henrique Cordeiro Ramalho and collaborators - GAPEG

plugins.name: GhanaPostGPS Geocoder
plugins.description: Convert between GhanaPostGPS digital addresses and geographic coordinates. Geocode addresses to points and reverse-geocode points to GhanaPostGPS addresses.
plugins.about:
A QGIS plugin for geocoding and reverse-geocoding using Ghana's GhanaPostGPS digital address system. Features include:
- Convert GhanaPostGPS addresses (e.g. AK-484-9321) to latitude/longitude point features
- Convert point layers or coordinate pairs to GhanaPostGPS addresses
- Single address lookup with instant map visualization
- Batch geocoding from a text field in any vector layer
- Batch reverse-geocoding from any point layer
- Rich attribute output including Region, District, PostCode, Area, and Street
- Configurable API endpoint (default: ghanapostgps.sperixlabs.org)
plugins.author: Ben Emunah Aikins

plugins.name: Global CMT Beachball Plotter
plugins.description:
Visualize Global CMT focal mechanisms as SVG beachballs in QGIS.
Supports psmeca, psvelomeca, CMTSOLUTION, and Full format files.
plugins.about:
This plugin automates the process of parsing Global CMT text files,
calculating Mw from moment tensor components, and creating georeferenced
focal mechanism symbols (beachballs) as SVG layers.
Ideal for seismologists and geophysicists.
plugins.author: Murat Beyhan

plugins.name: qfit
plugins.description: Explore fitness data spatially in QGIS
plugins.about: qfit imports and visualizes fitness activity data in QGIS, starting with Strava and expanding toward broader FIT/GPX workflows.
plugins.author: Emmanuel Belo

plugins.name: Dux Hodos
plugins.description: Navigate scattered vector point data feature-by-feature with highlight, sort, nearest-neighbour, area/raster filter and quick Y/N/D field editing.
plugins.about: Dux Hodos provides a dock panel for navigating location-based scattered point data one feature at a time. Key capabilities: sequential and nearest-neighbour navigation, multi-field drag-to-reorder sort, area boundary filter (polygon layer), multi-raster tile filter, quick Y/N/D attribute editing with live count, bulk apply to selected features, Google Satellite and Street View integration, and map-click-to-jump. Compatible with QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x (Qt5 and Qt6).
plugins.author: Ajay Nafria Mandhana & Sharma A

plugins.name: Memorial Integrativo Topografia
plugins.description: Gera memorial descritivo capturando confrontantes com cliques no mapa e exporta tabela de coordenadas em DXF, modelo topograph
plugins.about: Plugin that generates descriptive memorials and coordinate tables, based on the Topograph standard. Adjoiners can be added via text input or by selecting a named point directly on the map. Finally, it gives you the option to generate a coordinate table including distances and azimuths.
plugins.author: Thiago Norio Santos Igarashi

plugins.name: Shift Raster
plugins.description: Move a raster layer by specified amounts in the X and Y directions
plugins.about:
A processing algorithm for moving a raster layer.

Once installed you will find the tool in the processing toolbox.

The X and Y values will be in the same units as the coordinate refence system of the layer. (i.e. if the layer is in a metre-based CRS, x and y will move the layer in metres; if in degrees it will be in degrees)

Compatible with batch processing if you want to move lots of rasters at the same time.

Works on all rasters that open with gdal (that's most rasters in qgis, but not web maps for example)
plugins.author: Angus McBride

plugins.name: QStoryMap
plugins.description: A QGIS plugin for publishing QGIS projects as static story-map.
plugins.about:
QStoryMap is a free, open‑source QGIS plugin that exports QGIS project’s vector and raster layers into a static Leaflet story map website.

No server required: exports layers as local XYZ tiles.
Story sections: optional narrative sections that guide readers through the map.
One‑click publishing: publish your story map directly to GitHub Pages from QGIS.

Example story map — a live example of what you can publish with QStoryMap: https://amanchry.github.io/kenya-health-access/
plugins.author: Aman Chaudhary

plugins.name: Advanced Photo Importer
plugins.description: Import, manage and visualize geotagged photos with EXIF data in QGIS
plugins.about:
Advanced Photo Importer is a powerful QGIS plugin that simplifies the integration
of geotagged photos into your GIS projects. It automatically extracts GPS coordinates,
direction, and timestamp from EXIF data, creates point layers, and provides intuitive
tools for managing, filtering, labeling, and visualizing your field photos on the map.

Key features:
- Import photos from file or folder (recursive) with automatic EXIF extraction
- Create point layers (in-memory or saved as GPKG/Shapefile)
- Customizable SVG camera markers with rotation based on photo direction
- Date/time range filtering independent of manual visibility control
- Label styling with font, color, size, and buffer controls
- Click-on-map tool to open photos
- Export/import photo metadata to/from Excel
- Group management for organizing photos

All required Python libraries (exifread, openpyxl) are bundled with the plugin.
No additional installation is needed — everything works out of the box.
plugins.author: Dr. Majid Jazebi

plugins.name: IEPNB Tools
plugins.description: Comprehensive management, spatial analysis, and reporting for the Spanish Inventory of Natural Heritage and Biodiversity (IEPNB)
plugins.about:
Herramienta técnica de la Dirección General de Biodiversidad, Bosques y Desertificación para la gestión del Inventario Español del Patrimonio Natural y la Biodiversidad (IEPNB).

ES - Funcionalidades:
1. Identificación espacial avanzada y reportes automáticos (ENP, RN2000, MUP...).
2. Buscador territorial optimizado por capas y por término municipal.
3. Integración con la API EIDOS: consulta de especies y distribución.
4. Acceso a servicios interoperables WMS (MFE, Copernicus, PNOA, EIKOS, BDN, DGA, LULUCF, IDEE MITECO...).
5. Consulta integrada en la fototeca del CENEAM.
6. Herramientas de contexto: Cartografía base y Google Street View.

plugins.name: ANM Poligonal
plugins.description: For geologists and mining engineers in Brazil: QGIS plugin to design ANM-compliant mining polygons (true N–S / E–W orthogonal bearings), generate descriptive memorials, and export SHP, TXT and CSV in EPSG:4674 (SIRGAS 2000) for direct REPEM submission.
plugins.about:
EN: Designed for geologists and mining engineers working with Brazilian mineral rights, this QGIS plugin automates the polygon design workflow required for ANM mineral research applications.

Under ANM Resolution 119/2022 and the Código de Mineração (Decree-Law 227/1967), mineral research applications require a single polygon defined by sequential vertices in SIRGAS 2000 (EPSG:4674), with each segment strictly aligned to true North–South or East–West bearings — no diagonal segments allowed. The descriptive memorial (.CSV) generated from this geometry is the exclusive source used by ANM to locate the area in the REPEM system.

Key features:
- Strict orthogonal geometry enforcement (N–S / E–W true bearings, no crossing segments)
- Sketch orthogonalization: converts freehand or imported polygons into ANM-compliant geometry
- Restriction layer overlay: supports spatial intersection analysis with user-provided layers (e.g. indigenous territories, protected areas, encumbered zones)
- Batch processing for multiple polygons
- Export to Shapefile, TXT, and CSV in EPSG:4674

Replaces a time-consuming manual digitizing workflow with an automated, standardized process — letting professionals focus on the geology, not the geometry.

Questions or feedback? Connect with the author on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/-andre-souza/
Or send an e-mail to: andre.kavernista@gmail.com

PT-BR: Desenvolvido para geólogos e engenheiros de minas que atuam com direito minerário no Brasil, este plugin QGIS automatiza o fluxo de construção da poligonal exigida nos requerimentos de pesquisa mineral da ANM.

Conforme a Resolução ANM nº 119/2022 e o Código de Mineração (Decreto-Lei nº 227/1967), o requerimento de pesquisa exige uma única poligonal definida por vértices sequenciais em SIRGAS 2000 (EPSG:4674), com segmentos estritamente orientados a norte-sul ou leste-oeste verdadeiros — sem segmentos diagonais. O memorial descritivo (.CSV) gerado a partir dessa geometria é a fonte exclusiva utilizada pela ANM para locação da área no sistema REPEM.

Funcionalidades principais:
- Enforçamento rigoroso de geometria ortogonal (rumos N–S / L–O verdadeiros, sem cruzamento de segmentos)
- Ortogonalização de esboços: converte polígonos em esboço ou importados em geometria conforme ANM
- Sobreposição de camadas de restrição: suporta análise de interseção espacial com camadas fornecidas pelo usuário (ex.: terras indígenas, unidades de conservação, áreas oneradas)
- Processamento em lote de múltiplas poligonais
- Exportação para Shapefile, TXT e CSV em EPSG:4674

Substitui um fluxo de digitalização manual e demorado por um processo automatizado e padronizado — permitindo que o profissional concentre seu tempo na geologia, não na geometria.

Dúvidas ou sugestões? Conecte-se com o autor no LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/-andre-souza/
Ou envie um e-mail para: andre.kavernista@gmail.com

plugins.name: CartoDruid Device Sync
plugins.description: Synchronize projects between CartoDruid and QGIS. Configurable for other device files.
plugins.about:
CartoDruid Device Sync is a <b>QGIS plugin</b> designed to synchronize files between a <b>PC</b> and one or more <b>mobile devices</b>.
It enables fast and efficient data exchange between <b>QGIS projects</b> and the fieldwork tool <b>CartoDruid, without relying on cloud services</b>.

Although focused on <b>CartoDruid projects</b>, the plugin is <b>data-agnostic</b> and can be used to synchronize any folder structure between a mobile device and a PC.
For the time being, the plugin is fully functional on Windows and partially functional on Linux (Only ADB protocol works on Linux).

Communication is performed via:
- <b>ADB (Android Debug Bridge)</b> as the primary transport protocol (currently via cable only).
- <b>MTP (Media Transfer Protocol)</b> as a fallback when ADB is not available.

Key features:
- <b>Automatic detection of CartoDruid projects:</b> scans device folders to locate projects and generate synchronization settings.
- <b>Project configuration synchronization:</b> copies and updates CartoDruid project configuration files.
- <b>Vector data synchronization:</b> synchronizes vector layers and adds them automatically to the QGIS Table of Contents (<b>TOC</b>).
- <b>Georeferenced image synchronization:</b> copies images from the device and incorporates them as geo-tagged photo layers.
- <b>Generic folder synchronization:</b> can synchronize any folder between the device and PC, beyond CartoDruid-specific data.
This plugin enables teams to synchronize field data locally, without relying on cloud services.

External dependencies: The plugin uses the <b>ADB binary</b>. You can download and install the binary using a button in the plugin configuration. <b>Further information</b> can be found in the documentation in the readme or at <a href="https://docs.cartodruid.es/es/latest/qgisPlugin/qgis_plugin/">https://docs.cartodruid.es/es/latest/qgisPlugin/qgis_plugin/</a>.

<b>Download CartoDruid</b> from <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.jcyl.ita.crtdrd">https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.jcyl.ita.crtdrd</a>!

plugins.name: Voxel-Based Urban Microclimate Engine (VUME)
plugins.description:
VUME (Voxel-Based Urban Microclimate Engine) is a QGIS plugin designed to transform urban spatial data into microclimate intelligence using voxel-based modeling.
It enables advanced analysis of thermal comfort, solar exposure, sky view factor, green visibility, and shading dynamics derived from urban morphology, terrain, and vegetation structure.

The plugin integrates spatial modeling and analytical visualization into a unified workflow for urban microclimate assessment and planning decision support.

It includes:
1. Voxel-Based Urban Analyzer for generating microclimate indicators from spatial datasets.
2. Interactive Web Viewer for 3D exploration of urban form, terrain, and environmental indicators.
3. Analytical Outputs including physical-unit indicators such as SVF, GVI, GHI, and shadow metrics.
plugins.about:
VUME provides a lightweight yet powerful framework for urban microclimate analysis by bridging voxel-based spatial modeling with planning-oriented decision support.
The system enables proxy-based environmental intelligence derived from commonly available GIS datasets, supporting applications in urban planning, climate-sensitive design, and spatial policy evaluation.

Conceptually inspired by the voxel-based urban modeling framework introduced in VoxCity (Fujiwara et al., 2026), and extended toward urban microclimate intelligence, spatial analytics, and decision-support systems.

plugins.name: SCAPE-CA: Spatial Cellular Automata with Patch-based Evolution
plugins.description:
SCAPE-CA (Spatial Cellular Automata with Patch-based Evolution) is a QGIS plugin designed to simulate land-use and built-up growth using machine learning, cellular automata, patch-based allocation, planning constraints, and ensemble uncertainty analysis.
It enables advanced spatial simulation of urban expansion, land-cover transition, future built-up scenarios, and policy-based growth control using historical raster time series and spatial drivers.

The plugin integrates transition probability modelling, multi-class land-cover learning, spatial plan constraints, demand projection, uncertainty mapping, and automated diagnostic reporting into a unified workflow for urban and regional planning analysis.

It includes:
1. Spatial Cellular Automata Growth Simulator for projecting future built-up and land-cover change.
2. Multi-Class Transition Learning for detecting source land-cover classes that historically convert into built-up areas.
3. Scenario-Based Demand Engine using Auto CAGR, manual targets, population-driven demand, planned built-up capacity, and hybrid plan-constrained demand.
4. Ensemble Simulation Outputs including agreement maps, uncertainty maps, probability surfaces, and smart best-run selection.
5. Automated Diagnostic Reports including validation metrics, multi-resolution FoM, driver contribution, SHAP-style attribution, Bayesian demand posterior, landscape metrics, Markdown report, PNG summary, and professional PDF report.
plugins.about:
SCAPE-CA provides a research-grade yet practical framework for simulating urban growth and land-use transition in QGIS.
The system combines machine learning transition probability, cellular automata, patch-based spatial allocation, planning constraints, and explainable diagnostics to support evidence-based spatial planning, RDTR/RTRW evaluation, urban expansion analysis, and scenario-based policy assessment.

The tool is intended for planners, researchers, GIS analysts, and policy analysts who need to explore future spatial growth patterns, evaluate development constraints, identify uncertainty zones, and produce reproducible diagnostic outputs for technical reports and planning documents.

SCAPE-CA is designed as a scenario simulation and decision-support tool. Its outputs should be interpreted as analytical projections based on historical patterns, spatial drivers, demand assumptions, and model parameters, not as deterministic predictions of future land-use change.
plugins.author: Firman Afrianto, Maya Safira

- Dockable chat panel for asking questions about the current QGIS project
- QGIS-safe GeoAgent tools for layer inspection, map navigation, data loading, selection, processing, and project operations
- Confirmation-gated PyQGIS script execution fallback for QGIS API tasks without a dedicated tool
- Provider and model controls for Bedrock, OpenAI, ChatGPT/Codex OAuth, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Ollama, and LiteLLM
- Voice prompt recording with OpenAI speech-to-text transcription into the chat editor
- Image-aware chat with clipboard paste support for providers and models that support vision inputs
- Screenshot attachments from the map canvas, selected map regions, the QGIS window, and selected screen regions
- Clickable image previews with save/export actions

- Lazy startup checks to keep opening the chat dock responsive
- GitHub update checker
- Local installation and packaging scripts

Requirements:
- GeoAgent and provider/workflow clients, installable from Settings > Dependencies

plugins.name: QShare
plugins.description: Export a packaged QGIS project (layers + images + .qgz) preserving the layer tree group structure. Output as folder or ZIP, no external dependencies.
plugins.about: Package the active project: copy the vector layers (as SHP files mirroring the layer tree group structure, or in a single GPKG with table names that reflect the original groups), local rasters, and images used in layouts; rewrite the paths as relative; and save the .qgz file along with everything else. WMS/WMTS layers are retained with their original URLs. Export as a folder or as a .zip file. Does not modify the active project in QGIS.

plugins.name: Shp Lasso Tool
plugins.description: Lasso add/subtract editing with auto-dissolve, plus rectangle-select translation of polygon vertex chains for fast shapefile QC.
plugins.about: Two tools on the toolbar. (1) Lasso edit: left-drag adds and dissolves into the active polygon layer; right-drag (or Ctrl+Left) subtracts. (2) Edge multi-select: drag a rectangle to highlight a chain of polygon vertices in white (Shift+drag to add to the selection), then drag the chain to translate it; unselected vertices stay put so boundary edges stretch automatically. Arrow keys nudge by 1 screen pixel (Shift+Arrow by 10). Both tools share the same pan (middle / Space+Left) and zoom (wheel / +/-) gestures.
plugins.author: RFB Studio Ltd.

plugins.name: Save Temp Layers
plugins.description: Save all temporary/memory layers to disk with one click. Supports vector (GeoPackage/Shapefile/GeoJSON) and raster (GeoTIFF) layers.
plugins.about: When working with QGIS Processing tools, results are often stored as temporary (in-memory) layers that disappear when you close the project. This plugin detects all such temporary layers and lets you save them permanently in one click. Supports vector layers (saved as GeoPackage, Shapefile, or GeoJSON) and raster layers (saved as GeoTIFF). No external dependencies required — works on Windows, Linux, and macOS with a standard QGIS 3.x installation.
plugins.author: Cyanide

plugins.name: Dude, where's my window?
plugins.description: Ever had a window vanish off-screen, spawn somewhere unreachable, or hide behind everything else? This plugin rounds up all your floating undocked QGIS windows and herds them back onto the same screen as your map canvas — resized to fit, and cascaded so you can see them all.

plugins.name: TrendShift
plugins.description: Pixel-wise abrupt change point detection for raster time series using Pettitt's non-parametric test
plugins.about: TrendShift detects abrupt temporal shifts in time-ordered raster stacks. It estimates the most likely change point per pixel using Pettitt's non-parametric change point test and exports change step, change time, magnitude, direction, p-value, significance mask, and test statistic rasters. Designed for NDVI shifts, rangeland stress, forest disturbance, land-cover transitions represented as continuous indices, precipitation/temperature anomalies, water extent metrics, and other environmental raster time-series workflows.

plugins.name: LVT4U

plugins.name: GeoCSV Mapper
plugins.description: IT: Importa file CSV con coordinate in vari formati. Riconoscimento DMS, anteprima mappa e salvataggio GeoPackage. | EN: Import CSV files with coordinates in various formats. DMS recognition, map preview, and GeoPackage saving.
plugins.about:
IT: Questo plugin è uno strumento avanzato per l'importazione massiva di punti tramite file CSV in QGIS.
Offre un potente parser per il riconoscimento automatico sia delle coordinate decimali standard sia dei formati sessagesimali complessi (DMS). Implementa un'anteprima rapida su cartografia OpenStreetMap, verifica in tempo reale la codifica testuale e supporta l'esportazione automatizzata verso il moderno formato standard GeoPackage.

plugins.name: Quick CRS Fixer
plugins.description: Strumento avanzato per il rilevamento e la correzione automatica dei problemi di CRS / Advanced tool for automatic detection and correction of CRS issues
plugins.about: [IT] Quick CRS Fixer è un plugin essenziale per individuare e risolvere problematiche legate ai Sistemi di Riferimento delle Coordinate (CRS). Funzionalità principali: rilevamento automatico delle incongruenze geometriche; suggerimento intelligente dell'EPSG corretto tramite toponimi ed estensione spaziale; integrazione con OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) e Wikipedia; scheda Help; selettore lingua italiano/inglese. Compatible with QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.0+/Qt6. Developed for research and public utility.

plugins.name: GeoCalc
plugins.description: One-click geometric calculations: polygon area, line length, and point coordinates, with configurable units. Works with selected layers.
plugins.about: Adds a single toolbar button that, when clicked, processes all selected layers in the layer tree and adds (or overwrites) a geometry field according to the layer type: area for polygons, length for lines, and X/Y coordinates for points. Units and output precision are configurable from the plugin Settings dialog (m², ha, km², ft², ac, mi² for areas; m, km, ft, yd, mi for lengths). Calculations use the project's ellipsoid for accurate results regardless of the layer CRS. Read-only layers are silently skipped. If a target field already exists, its values are overwritten in place.

plugins.name: MapIC
plugins.description: Sentinel-2 spectral indices, supervised classification and automatic cartographic layout generation.
plugins.about: MapIC is a QGIS plugin for Sentinel-2 image processing, spectral indices calculation, Random Forest classification and professional map layout export.

plugins.name: OpenGeoEnrich
plugins.description: Open-source geoenrichment for QGIS: enrich points, lines, or polygons with open-data population, roads, facilities, land-cover, and terrain indicators.
plugins.about: OpenGeoEnrich is a QGIS Processing Toolbox plugin for adding contextual geospatial indicators to any vector layer. It supports prepared open-data folders, OSM auto-fetch for roads and facilities, optional WorldPop population preparation, optional ESA WorldCover 10 m land-cover preparation, optional Copernicus DEM GLO-30 preparation with slope/TRI derivation, and manual layer inputs for population, land cover, DEM, roads, and facilities.

plugins.name: toggle_layer_on_off

plugins.name: Tresbolillo Grid Generator
plugins.description: Creates staggered point grids inside polygon layers using a user-defined spacing and horizontal or vertical offset, including row and plant numbering.
plugins.about: Tresbolillo Grid Generator creates a staggered point grid inside polygon layers. It is designed for sampling, agricultural planning, field layouts, and GIS workflows that require a point pattern with alternating offsets. The generated point layer now includes automatic row and plant numbering fields: Hilera, Planta, and Codigo. With vertical offset, rows are numbered from west to east and plants from south to north. With horizontal offset, rows are numbered from south to north and plants from west to east. The input layer must use a projected coordinate reference system in meters, such as UTM. The plugin lets users choose the polygon layer, point spacing, output shapefile, and offset direction. No external dependencies are required.
plugins.author: Jorge H Caal Pineda

plugins.name: curvaCAV-GIS

plugins.about:
Plugin for calculation of Elevation-Area-Volume (CAV/EAV) curves from a DTM (Digital Terrain Model) raster in QGIS.
Supports clipping by polygon layer (with optional single-feature selection), current map extent, or
user-drawn rectangle on the map canvas. Results are displayed in a dedicated tab with an
interactive chart (Area and Volume vs Elevation) and a full Elevation-Area-Volume table,
exportable as CSV and PNG image.
No external Python dependencies required. Works on Windows, Linux and macOS.
Requirements: QGIS 3.16 or newer.

plugins.name: GeoPackage Converter
plugins.description: Batch convert vector files (SHP, TAB, KML, GML, GeoJSON, DXF, GPX, MIF, ZIP) to GeoPackage — from project or folder.
plugins.about: GeoPackage Converter converts vector files to GeoPackage in two modes: "From project" (preserving symbology from the active QGIS project) and "From folder" (recursive scan with automatic ZIP support via GDAL /vsizip/). Features: batch conversion of mixed formats, grouping strategies (all-in-one, per subfolder, per legend group, mirror folder structure), optional CRS reprojection with native QGIS selector, automatic encoding detection for shapefiles, style preservation inside GeoPackage, geometry validation, dry-run preview, background execution, HTML report, and Processing algorithms for automation. Works on any country and CRS. UI available in Italian, English and Spanish. Compatible with QGIS 3.34+ (Qt5) and 4.0+ (Qt6). --- Converte file vettoriali in GeoPackage con due modalità: "Da progetto" (preservando la simbologia) e "Da cartella" (scansione ricorsiva con supporto ZIP). plugins.name: SCS-CN Builder
plugins.description: Automated SCS Curve Number calculation from LULC and Hydrologic Soil Group data, with CN2/CN3 maps, basin statistics, quality-control checks and an HTML report.
plugins.about: SCS-CN Builder is a QGIS plugin for automated estimation of Curve Number values using the Soil Conservation Service method. It integrates land use/land cover raster data, Hydrologic Soil Group raster data and basin polygons to generate CN2 maps for average antecedent moisture conditions, CN3 maps for high antecedent moisture conditions, basin-level zonal statistics, quality-control summaries and an HTML calculation report.

plugins.name: RSRP Thematic Converter

This plugin requires pandas and geopandas in the QGIS Python environment.

plugins.name: ArcToQ Converter

plugins.about: A native QGIS plugin that reads ArcGIS JSON styling and translates vector, raster, and text symbology to their QGIS XML equivalents.

plugins.name: Crear Zonas de Influencia Personalizadas
plugins.description: Advanced buffer tool for QGIS with 9 buffer types (Circular, Oval, Rectangular, Concentric, By Area, One Side, Wedge, Adaptive by Density, Variable Width), dynamic field-based sizing, ISO 19157 quality reports, overlap analysis, parallel processing and dry-run validation.
plugins.about:
Crear Zonas de Influencia Personalizadas - Advanced Buffer Generator for QGIS.
Algoritmo integral de geoprocesamiento para la generacion de zonas de influencia personalizadas con control geometrico avanzado, auditoria de calidad y trazabilidad metodologica completa.
TIPOS DE BUFER (9): Circular, Oval, Rectangular, Concentrico, Por Area, Un Solo Lado, Cuna, Adaptativo por Densidad, Ancho Variable (Puntos).

plugins.description: Exports dip/strike point layers to KMZ with fully preserved symbol rotation. Fixes the rotation loss bug in QGIS's built-in KMZ exporter.
plugins.about: This plugin exports point layers (typically geological dip/strike measurements) to KMZ format while correctly preserving symbol rotation defined by a field or a fixed angle. The standard QGIS "Save As KMZ" tool loses rotation information; this plugin writes proper KML <heading> values inside <IconStyle> so the symbols appear rotated correctly in Google Earth and other KMZ viewers. Created with the help of Claude Ai.

plugins.name: Topologis Exporter

plugins.about: Publish QGIS vector layers to Topologis as interactive web maps that you can share with clients or embed on a website. Adds a "Publish to Topologis" toolbar button. Supports Point, Line, and Polygon layers with automatic reprojection to EPSG:4326. After upload, style the layers in the Topologis editor and create shareable views. Viewers open links anonymously, no account required. Free trial, no credit card.
